evidence.locator: Dataset organization; Parquet features; episode/video alignment
evidence.statement: The data card documents one complete episode per Parquet file, matching per-camera episode videos, timestamp/frame/episode indices, robot observations and action fields. This establishes an action-aligned temporal data path.
